Production Glossary · 41/50 · localization

Caption cue

Definition

Caption cue is a timed subtitle or caption unit containing text and optional speaker or positioning information. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align localization decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • True peak
  • Caption reading speed
